as_told.title: News report on the Langley drone incursions

plain: In 2023, drones are said to have swarmed Langley Air Force Base in Hampton, Virginia, for 17 days, and nobody could stop them. Michels tells it on several shows, adding that 'we have no defense against this' and that a former defense official named Chris Mellon said there was a mothership. A former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says the base houses F-22 jets and that they had to be moved to another base for fear of losing them. A news anchor, in a clip played on the show, says Air Force officials confirmed that 'several unmanned drones flew over Langley' the previous December, without giving a length of time. If true, it would mean unknown craft could loiter over a major US base at will.
